test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

A new strategy had been devised by the marketing team to increase sales.

options.text: The marketing team has devised a new strategy to increase sales.
The marketing team devises a new strategy to increase sales.
The marketing team had devised a new strategy to increase sales.
The marketing team was devising a new strategy to increase sales.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The marketing team had devised a new strategy to increase sales .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the **passive voice**, where the subject (marketing team) is acted upon.
 
• To convert the sentence into **active voice**, the subject (marketing team) must perform the action (devising a new strategy).
 
• Since the original sentence uses the past perfect tense **had been devised**, the active voice must also use the past perfect tense **had devised**.

Correct sentence: *The marketing team had devised a new strategy to increase sales*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive Voice:** Focuses on the action and the receiver of the action.
 
 
• **Structure:** Object + auxiliary verb (be) + past participle + by + subject.
 
• **Example:** The book was written by the author.
 
 
 
• **Active Voice:** Focuses on the subject performing the action.
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + verb + object.
 
• **Example:** The author wrote the book.
